notes.title: "Retrace The Light" will be released in November this year!
notes.notes:
[p]"Retrace The Light" is a 2.5D top-down action adventure game that employs a space-time rewind mechanism, focusing on an integrated gameplay experience of combat, exploration, and puzzle-solving, allowing you to enjoy the thrill of challenges. In the game, players take on the role of an AI worker - Executor Shi, infiltrating the mental world of paranoid patients to uncover the causes of their paranoia and eliminate their obsessions. 
Currently, "Trace of Light" has officially announced its release date for November this year! [/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43149099/bc64b6d7cee5c8806cf4d32fed85efb3fd463935.png"][/img][/p][p]I. Light Souls-like, Challenge Yourself[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43149099/48c1175e8e4c2215e085ca924bf80f7fc405704c.gif"][/img][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43149099/146a410f50156330728f61024d55926464ab0c83.gif"][/img][/p][p]- The game combines hardcore combat feel with smooth gameplay experience. You can use various attack moves and quickly return to the battlefield from the save point after death.[/p][p]- Boss battles come in different forms. Each enemy has unique behavior patterns and stage transitions, requiring observation, learning, and precise counterattacks.[/p][p]- The combat system is both strategic and operational, demanding your timing and move responses. [/p][p][/p][p]II. "Light Slit" Mechanism, Unique Puzzle Solving[/p][p]· The original "Light Slit" system allows you to break away from linear thinking and explore various interaction possibilities.[/p][p]· For instance, when encountering a path that is temporarily impassable, you can leave a light slit at the mechanism's location and then use the backtracking mechanism to activate the mechanism, thus reaching the other side.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43149099/aa193f76b31aae2d63c394f4905b5d8e54756382.gif"][/img][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43149099/ee46e7238ad24646f9fef3c0f4fb48f8e1acfef7.gif"][/img][/p][p]· Besides solving puzzles, you can also ingeniously utilize the backtracking function of "light slits" to dodge enemy attacks and counterattack! [/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43149099/146a410f50156330728f61024d55926464ab0c83.gif"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]III. Textured Art Style, Sci-Fi Aesthetics[/p][p]- The overall art style leans towards future technology, with each map reflecting a different scene from a unique, eccentric individual, catering to your demands for diverse gaming experiences.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43149099/38662363fe9aa64be9ce24a5e48a9e87f6b9f75e.png"][/img][/p][p]- Most scenes feature a distinctive top-down perspective, allowing you to control the character with ease. Additionally, there is a side-scrolling platformer mode, offering you a variety of gameplay experiences.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43149099/0753ad2e075232a5784022c62c0a728a4edb78a9.gif"][/img][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43149099/693e7391bd294ba361cb58bfd49cc7a058feb3cf.gif"][/img][/p][p]- Utilizing the Unreal Engine, dynamic lighting and particle effects enhance the immersion of battles, allowing you to fully enjoy the visual spectacle of skill releases and interactions with the environment. [/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43149099/8e0f65280b8b581234fef89a1b243a313080e10f.gif"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]IV. Fragmented Narratives, Piecing Together the Truth[/p][p]· Breaking down the barriers between virtual and reality, it tells the stories of AI executors, each with distinct personality traits.[/p][p]· You can gradually piece together the truth behind "Yuan" and the executors through fragmented dialogues and environmental texts.[/p]

notes.title: The new Demo was released on January 21st!
notes.notes:
[h1]"Retrace the Light" Demo Now Available[/h1]
[list] [*]Attention all Enforcers, we have great news to announce: After several months of intensive development, the overall completion of the game "Retrace the Light" is now approaching the release stage, and we are getting closer to officially meeting you all.
[*] Therefore, we plan to release a Demo on [b]January 21st[/b], to help those who are interested in the game to take a close look at the actual gameplay experience! The Demo will be permanently available on the store page, and we will continue to update it, with no plans to take it down in the near future.

[previewyoutube=gUKhKSeJ5JE;full][/previewyoutube]
[*] This demo includes [b]the complete tutorial level and the introduction part of an official level[/b]. After completing the main storyline, which lasts about [b]40 minutes[/b], if you're still craving more, you can [b]enter the Combat Simulation Program to challenge a combat of mid-game difficulty[/b]. (Here's a secret: your opponent is your fellow Enforcer.)
[*] Compared to the full version, some growth elements such as [b]Iteration System and Booster Modules[/b] are only partially available in the Demo (including 6 Major Modules and 5 Minor Modules), and they will be automatically unlocked when entering the Combat Simulation Program. 
[*] If you encounter any issues or have suggestions while playing the Demo, feel free to share them with us in the Steam comment section. We wish you success in executing your missions in the Realm of Meta Mirror! 

[*]The Japanese, English, and Simplified Chinese localizations of the game have been implemented. If your language is not available, please don’t worry. Our localization plan is as follows: Spanish will be implemented by the end of January, and Korean, French, and Traditional Chinese will be implemented in February.
[/list]

notes.title: The demo is over now, looking forward to seeing you next time
notes.notes:
[h2]The demo is over now, looking forward to seeing you next time[/h2]

During this Steam  Festival, as producers, we are very happy to see that thousands of players have tried the demo. Thank you for your support and love for "Trace the Light"!

With the end of the Steam festival, we have temporarily closed the download channel of the game demo. I believe that everyone has not enjoyed the game during this period of time, but there is no need to regret, the follow-up development of the game is still in progress, and all members of the studio are working hard to make "Traveling the Light" a better and more complete posture next time Meet the players.

Finally, thanks again to all of you who came to play during the Steam Festival!
